plan: This is a second-price sealed-bid auction, where bidding your true value is the dominant strategy regardless of others' bids or strategies. Since I only pay the second-highest bid if I win, bidding above my value risks losses if I win at a higher price, while bidding below my value risks losing profitable opportunities. With no prior history to suggest otherwise, and given the theoretical guarantee that truthful bidding maximizes expected profit in second-price auctions, I will bid exactly my value of $39.

This is a second-price auction, where the dominant strategy is to bid exactly your true value. Bidding your value ensures you win whenever your value exceeds both opponents' bids (maximizing profit), and you never overpay since you only pay the second-highest bid, not your own bid. Bidding higher risks paying more than your value if others bid between your value and your bid; bidding lower risks losing profitable opportunities. Thus, the optimal bid equals my value of $34.
